name: qingpet
description: QQ群宠物养成系统：领养、喂养、互动与社交
author: XiaoQing

commands.name: qingpet
commands.help: QQ群宠物养成系统：照料、道具、社交、玩法与群管理

subcommands.name: adopt
subcommands.help: 在当前群领养并命名一只宠物

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.help: 查看自己的宠物状态和资产

subcommands.name: feed
subcommands.help: 使用指定食物或默认食物喂宠物
invalid_examples: /宠物 feed 不存在的食物

subcommands.name: clean
subcommands.help: 清洁自己的宠物

subcommands.name: play
subcommands.help: 和自己的宠物玩耍

subcommands.name: sleep
subcommands.help: 让自己的宠物睡觉

subcommands.name: wake
subcommands.help: 唤醒自己的宠物

subcommands.name: train
subcommands.help: 训练宠物的体力、敏捷或智力
subcommands.usage: /宠物 train [群号] [体力|敏捷|智力]

subcommands.name: explore
subcommands.help: 让宠物前往指定区域探索
subcommands.usage: /宠物 explore [群号] [森林|海边|山洞|废墟]

subcommands.name: treat
subcommands.help: 使用药品治疗自己的宠物
invalid_examples: /宠物 treat 不存在的药品

subcommands.name: rename
subcommands.help: 修改自己的宠物名字

subcommands.name: recall
subcommands.help: 召回旅行中的宠物

subcommands.name: backpack
subcommands.help: 查看自己的道具背包

subcommands.name: shop
subcommands.help: 查看普通道具商店

subcommands.name: buy
subcommands.help: 购买普通道具

subcommands.name: use
subcommands.help: 使用背包中的加速卡或托管券

subcommands.name: gift
subcommands.help: 向群友赠送道具

subcommands.name: dress
subcommands.help: 查看、购买、穿戴或卸下宠物装扮

subcommands.name: view
subcommands.help: 查看当前装扮和已拥有装扮

subcommands.name: shop
subcommands.help: 查看装扮商店

subcommands.name: buy
subcommands.help: 购买指定装扮

subcommands.name: equip
subcommands.help: 穿戴指定装扮

subcommands.name: unequip
subcommands.help: 卸下指定槽位装扮
subcommands.usage: /宠物 dress unequip <帽子|衣服|饰品|背景>

subcommands.name: visit
subcommands.help: 访问群友的宠物

subcommands.name: view
subcommands.help: 查看群友的宠物资料

subcommands.name: like
subcommands.help: 给群友的宠物点赞或摸摸

subcommands.name: message
subcommands.help: 查看自己的留言或给群友留言

subcommands.name: ranking
subcommands.help: 查看照顾、亲密度、经验或金币排行

subcommands.name: trade
subcommands.help: 查看或操作群交易市场

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.help: 查看当前群交易挂单

subcommands.name: sell
subcommands.help: 上架背包道具
subcommands.usage: /宠物 trade sell <道具ID> <数量> <价格>

subcommands.name: buy
subcommands.help: 购买交易列表返回的订单号

subcommands.name: cancel
subcommands.help: 撤销交易列表中自己的订单号
examples: /宠物 trade cancel <自己的订单号>

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.help: 查看宠物展示会或投票

subcommands.name: vote
subcommands.help: 在当前展示会中给群友宠物投票

subcommands.name: game
subcommands.help: 玩猜拳、骰子或宠物赛跑

subcommands.name: rps
subcommands.help: 与系统猜拳

subcommands.name: dice
subcommands.help: 进行一次骰子比大小

subcommands.name: race
subcommands.help: 和群友的宠物赛跑

subcommands.name: task
subcommands.help: 查看或领取个人每日任务

subcommands.name: claim
subcommands.help: 领取已完成的个人每日任务奖励

subcommands.name: group_task
subcommands.help: 查看或领取当前群的每日任务

subcommands.name: claim
subcommands.help: 领取已完成的群任务奖励

subcommands.name: title
subcommands.help: 查看自己的宠物称号并结算新称号

subcommands.name: activity
subcommands.help: 查看群活动或领取活动奖励

subcommands.name: claim
subcommands.help: 领取活动列表返回的已完成活动 ID

subcommands.name: admin
subcommands.help: 管理当前群宠物系统、用户、审计与活动

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.help: 开启当前群宠物系统

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.help: 关闭当前群宠物系统

subcommands.name: config
subcommands.help: 查看或修改当前群宠物配置

subcommands.name: 查看
subcommands.help: 查看当前群宠物配置
invalid_examples: /宠物 admin config 查看 extra

subcommands.name: 设置
subcommands.help: 修改一个允许的群配置项
examples: /宠物 admin config 设置 trade_enabled true
invalid_examples: /宠物 admin config 设置 trade_enabled

subcommands.name: reset
subcommands.help: 重置指定用户宠物状态，需二次确认

subcommands.name: delete
subcommands.help: 永久删除指定用户宠物，需二次确认

subcommands.name: ban
subcommands.help: 在当前群封禁用户若干天

subcommands.name: unban
subcommands.help: 解除用户在当前群的封禁

subcommands.name: log
subcommands.help: 查看最近 1 至 100 条管理员操作日志

subcommands.name: stats
subcommands.help: 查看当前群宠物聚合统计

subcommands.name: announce
subcommands.help: 开启或结束宠物展示会
examples: /宠物 admin announce show 夏日展示会

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.help: 开启宠物展示会
examples: /宠物 admin announce show 夏日展示会
invalid_examples: /宠物 admin announce show a b c d e

subcommands.name: end_show
subcommands.help: 立即结束并结算当前展示会

subcommands.name: activity
subcommands.help: 创建宠物行为驱动的限时群活动
subcommands.usage: /宠物 admin activity create <类型> <目标数> <奖励金币> [标题]
examples: /宠物 admin activity create feed 20 100 喂食挑战

subcommands.name: create
subcommands.help: 创建群活动
subcommands.usage: /宠物 admin activity create <feed|clean|play|train|explore> <目标数> <奖励金币> [标题]
examples: /宠物 admin activity create feed 20 100 喂食挑战
invalid_examples: /宠物 admin activity create feed zero 100

subcommands.help: 显示完整宠物命令目录，可附帮助类别

subcommands.help: 筛选道具与装扮命令帮助

schedule.description: 每天 00:00 重置每日状态
每 5 分钟结算到期交易挂单
每分钟结算到期展示会
每周一 10:00 结算周活动
